## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    \left\{
    \begin{aligned}
    \frac{d p_1}{dt} & = c_1 p_1 (1 - p_1) - e_1 p_1\\
    \frac{d p_2}{dt} & = c_2 p_2 (1 - (p_1 + p_2)) - e_1 p_2 - c_1 p_1 p_2
    \end{aligned}
    \right.
$${#eq-cc-tradeoff}
